items.markdown:
You can learn more about the legal and technical definitions on the [Federal Tax Authority - UAE E-Invoicing](https://tax.gov.ae/en/content/uae.einvoicing.aspx) portal.[[1]](https://tax.gov.ae/en/content/uae.einvoicing.aspx)

The United Arab Emirates is rolling out a mandatory e-invoicing system using a decentralized 5-corner Peppol model to automate tax reporting and improve compliance. Unstructured formats like PDFs, scanned copies, or emails are not recognized as valid e-invoices under this framework.[[1]](https://www.grantthornton.ae/services/tax/vat/e-invoicing-services/)[[2]](https://edicomgroup.com/electronic-invoicing/united-arab-emirates)[[3]](https://tax.gov.ae/en/content/uae.einvoicing.aspx)

### Key Deadlines & Phased Rollout

- **October 30, 2026:** Deadline for businesses with annual revenues of AED 50 million or more to appoint an Accredited Service Provider (ASP).
- **January 1, 2027:** Mandatory e-invoicing implementation begins for large businesses (revenue ≥ AED 50 million).
- **March 31, 2027:** Deadline for smaller businesses and government entities to appoint an ASP.
- **July 1, 2027:** Mandatory implementation for businesses with revenues under AED 50 million.
- **October 1, 2027:** Mandatory implementation for government entities (B2G).[[1]](https://edicomgroup.com/electronic-invoicing/united-arab-emirates)[[2]](https://gulfnews.com/uae/dubai/uae-e-invoicing-deadline-nears-is-your-business-ready-1.500693633)[[3]](https://www.arabianbusiness.com/business/uae-tax-deadline-warning)[[4]](https://gulfnews.com/business/tax-news/e-invoicing-countdown-what-uae-companies-must-do-before-october-30-1.500692228)

### Core Requirements & Framework

- **Format:** Must be a structured digital format (such as XML / PINT AE) that allows automatic processing.
- **Model:** Uses the Peppol 5-corner decentralised network, where the Federal Tax Authority acts as the fifth corner to securely capture transaction data in near real-time.
- **Scope:** Initially covers B2B (business-to-business) and B2G (business-to-government) transactions; B2C is currently excluded.
- **Provider:** Companies must contract and integrate through an FTA-Approved Service Provider prior to their respective deadlines.[[1]](https://www.hawksford.com/insights-and-guides/uae-e-invoicing)[[2]](https://www.grantthornton.ae/services/tax/vat/e-invoicing-services/)[[3]](https://edicomgroup.com/electronic-invoicing/united-arab-emirates)[[4]](https://www.comarch.com/trade-and-services/data-management/e-invoicing/e-invoicing-in-uae/)[[5]](https://tax.gov.ae/en/content/uae.einvoicing.aspx)[[6]](https://www.meydanfz.ae/blog/e-invoicing-in-uae-explained)[[7]](https://gulfnews.com/business/tax-news/e-invoicing-countdown-what-uae-companies-must-do-before-october-30-1.500692228)

If you'd like, let me know:

- Your business's **annual revenue bracket** 
- Whether you need help finding an **Accredited Service Provider** 

I can give you a tailored checklist for your transition.
